(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE D K SINGH) The present intra Court appeal has been filed impugning the judgment and order dated 22.01.2026 passed by the learned Single Judge in W.P.No.10028/2024 (LA-BDA), filed by appellant herein.
2. The parties are referred to as per their ranking before the learned Single Judge, for the sake of convenience.

sentences.text:
The petitioner, who claims right on the basis of some unregistered agreement of sale in respect of the land in question initially challenged the land acquisition proceedings - 11 - NC: 2026:KHC:14071-DB HC-KAR in respect of the lands in Item Nos.1 to 28, for which the preliminary notification under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short 'the Act')
was issued on 30.05.1988 and thereafter, the final notification under Section 6(1) of the Act came to be issued on 15.03.1989.
4. The land owners' challenge to the said acquisition proceedings in W.P.Nos.8188-8201/1989 before the learned Single Judge, met with success vide order dated 11.07.1996.

5. M/s.Trinity House Building Co-operative Society, which was respondent No.4 in W.P.Nos.8188-8201/1989 challenged the order dated 11.07.1996 passed by the learned Single Judge before the Division Bench in Writ Appeal Nos.7543-7557/1996 and connected matters.
The Division Bench vide judgment and order dated 06.05.2004 allowed the appeals and set aside the judgment of the learned Single Judge.
The owners challenged the decision of the Division Bench before the Supreme Court by filing SLP (C) Nos.13656-13684/2004.

However, the Supreme Court vide order dated 15.09.2016 dismissed the said S.L.Ps.
7.
The petitioner who claims right on the basis of some unregistered Agreement to sell and power of attorney filed impleading applications before the Supreme Court in the pending Civil Appeals.

However, the Supreme Court dismissed the applications with the following observation:-
"45.

The Impleadment Application Nos.74-102 of 2010 filed in the appeals arising out of SLP (C) Nos.13656-13684 of 2004 are also liable to be rejected, as the applicant therein claims to be the power-of-Attorney(s) holder of some of the lands in question and agreements of sale.

Since he neither approached the High Court nor this Court by way of filing SLPs and neither the agreements of sale nor the power of attorney(s)
confer any right upon him at this time, as the same is barred by the provisions of the Land Reforms Act, 1952, provisions of the Specific Relief Act as well as the Limitation Act, the - 13 - NC: 2026:KHC:14071-DB HC-KAR applicant has no legal right to come on record to challenge the impugned judgment and therefore the Impleadment Applications are Sri Mohammed Zaheer vs Bangalore Development Authority on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102311679/
10 rejected, as the same are wholly unsustainable in law."

entities.text: Sri Mohammed Zaheer vs Bangalore Development Authority
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. After the Supreme Court decided the issue finally, the appellant/petitioner has filed writ petition before the learned Single Judge.

The learned Single Judge vide impugned judgment and order dated 22.01.2026 has dismissed the writ petition by observing as under :-
"This Court was following the judgment of the Apex Court wherein the Apex Court holds that an agreement holder registered or unregistered would not get any right whatsoever, as the instrument of conveyance requires the agreement of sale to be taken to its logical conclusion, which has not happened therein and which did not happen in the case at hand as well.
Therefore, the agreements of sale have remained as agreements.
Thus, the petitioner has no right to claim compensation, plainly on the observation of the Apex Court on his impleading application, as quoted hereinabove."

9. We see no reason to interfere with the impugned Judgment and Order dated 22.01.2026 passed by the - 14 - NC: 2026:KHC:14071-DB HC-KAR learned Single Judge inasmuch so far as the rights of the petitioner on the basis of unregistered agreement of sale and power of attorney are concerned, the Supreme Court has already decided the issue finally and nothing is left to be decided by this Court.
Therefore, we dismiss this writ appeal.
10. In view dismissal of the appeal, pending interim applications, if any do not survive for consideration, hence stand disposed of.

Sd/-
